title: Bilobalide attenuates steroid-induced osteonecrosis of the femoral head by upregulating the ERK/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway and promoting angiogenesis-osteogenesis coupling.
authors: Chen, Qi; Wang, Bo; Liang, Hu; Xu, Hanbo; Zhang, Kun; Hao, Yangquan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银杏内酯B通过ERK/HIF-1alpha信号通路治疗激素性股骨头坏死，虽含分子对接但核心是骨代谢与血管生成，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Steroid-induced osteonecrosis of the femoral head (SONFH) is a severe bone disease associated with long-term glucocorticoid use, characterized by impaired bone metabolism and vascular insufficiency. Bilobalide (BB), a natural sesquiterpene from Ginkgo biloba, exhibits anti-apoptotic, antioxidant, and pro-angiogenic properties, yet its role in SONFH remains unclear. We integrated network pharmacology and molecular docking to predict the targets and pathways of BB in SONFH. Key targets were validated using molecular docking software. For in vivo experiments, a rat SONFH model was established using methylprednisolone (MPS), and BB was administered orally. Micro-CT, H&E staining, TUNEL assay, and immunohistochemistry were employed to evaluate bone microstructure, apoptosis, and the expression of osteogenic and angiogenic markers. Immunofluorescence was used to assess HIF-1alpha expression in rat femoral head tissues. For in vitro experiments, MC3T3-E1 osteoblasts were treated with dexamethasone(DEX) and BB. Cell viability was detected using the CCK-8 assay, and the protein levels of the HIF-1alpha and ERK pathways were examined by Western blot. Network pharmacology identified 94 common targets between BB and SONFH, with enrichment in HIF-1 and ERK signaling pathways. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding affinities between BB and core targets. In MPS-induced rats, BB treatment significantly improved bone mineral density, trabecular microstructure, and reduced osteocyte apoptosis. BB also upregulated HIF-1alpha, Runx2, OCN, CD31, and VEGF expression, indicating enhanced osteogenesis and angiogenesis. In vitro, BB rescued dexamethasone-induced suppression of osteoblast viability and upregulated the ERK/HIF-1alpha pathway. Bilobalide attenuates SONFH progression by activating the ERK/HIF-1alpha signaling pathway, promoting osteogenesis and angiogenesis, and reducing osteocyte apoptosis. These findings highlight BB as a promising candidate for SONFH prevention and support the utility of network pharmacology in mechanistic natural product research.
abstract_zh: 激素性股骨头坏死（SONFH）是一种与长期使用糖皮质激素相关的严重骨病，其特征为骨代谢受损和血管功能不全。白果内酯（BB），一种来自银杏的天然倍半萜，具有抗凋亡、抗氧化和促血管生成特性，但其在SONFH中的作用尚不清楚。我们整合了网络药理学和分子对接，以预测BB在SONFH中的靶点和通路。关键靶点通过分子对接软件进行验证。在体内实验中，使用甲泼尼龙（MPS）建立大鼠SONFH模型，并口服给予BB。采用Micro-CT、H&E染色、TUNEL检测和免疫组织化学评估骨微结构、凋亡以及成骨和血管生成标志物的表达。使用免疫荧光评估大鼠股骨头组织中HIF-1α的表达。在体外实验中，用 dexamethasone（DEX）和BB处理MC3T3-E1成骨细胞。通过CCK-8检测细胞活力，并通过Western blot检测HIF-1α和ERK通路蛋白水平。网络药理学鉴定出BB与SONFH之间的94个共同靶点，富集于HIF-1和ERK信号通路。分子对接证实BB与核心靶点之间具有强结合亲和力。在MPS诱导的大鼠中，BB治疗显著改善了骨矿物质密度、小梁微结构，并减少了骨细胞凋亡。BB还上调了HIF-1α、Runx2、OCN、CD31和VEGF的表达，表明增强了成骨和血管生成。在体外，BB挽救了地塞米松诱导的成骨细胞活力抑制，并上调了ERK/HIF-1α通路。白果内酯通过激活ERK/HIF-1α信号通路，促进成骨和血管生成，并减少骨细胞凋亡，从而减轻SONFH进展。这些发现凸显了BB作为SONFH预防的有前景候选药物，并支持网络药理学在天然产物机制研究中的实用性。
